info.title: PataPlan API
info.description:
REST API for managing pet health, vaccination schedules, veterinary records, expense tracking and shelter operations.

All endpoints are prefixed with `/api`. Authentication uses JWT bearer tokens (obtained via `POST /api/auth/login`).
